card.name: Bullet after section reference numbers
card.fires_on: The bullet mark (•) that follows a parenthesized section number such as ( 5.6 ) in the highlights summary of a drug label. It also fires on a few list-starting marks like the period after a numeral "1".

modes.label: Bullet after section number
modes.description: A bullet that begins the next item right after a bracketed label cross-reference in the highlights section.

modes.label: Other list starts
modes.description: A bullet or period that starts a new list entry, such as a dictionary definition number or a criteria list.
